#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    explicit InputReader(istream& stream) : stream(stream) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int res = 0, c;
        c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

private:
    istream& stream;
    int read() {
        return stream.get();
    }
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

bool in(const vector<int>& a, int b, int l, int r) {
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (a[i] == b)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

int fun(int a, int b, int l, int r, InputReader& in_reader) {
    if ((r - l + 1) > 2 * (a + b))
        return (a <= b) ? a + 1 : (2 * a - b);

    int size = 3 * (a + b) + 1;
    vector<int> flag(size, 0);
    int temp = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        flag[i] = i;
        temp = i;
    }

    for (int i = a + 1; i <= a + b; i++) {
        flag[i] = temp;
    }

    for (int i = a + b + 1; i <= a + b + a; i++) {
        int tc = 1;
        while (in(flag, tc, a + b - a + 1, i - 1))
            tc++;
        flag[i] = tc;
        temp = flag[i];
    }

    for (int i = a + b + a + 1; i <= a + b + a + b; i++) {
        flag[i] = temp;
    }

    for (int i = 2 * (a + b) + 1; i <= 3 * (a + b); i++) {
        flag[i] = flag[i - (a + b)];
    }

    vector<int> flagc(25, 0);
    int templ = l % (a + b);
    if (templ == 0) templ += a + b;
    int tempr = r - l + templ;
    if (tempr < templ) tempr += a + b;

    for (int i = templ; i <= tempr; i++) {
        flagc[flag[i]] = 1;
    }

    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 24; i++)
        res += flagc[i];

    return res;
}

int main() {
    InputReader in_reader(cin);
    int a = in_reader.nextInt();
    int b = in_reader.nextInt();
    int l = in_reader.nextInt();
    int r = in_reader.nextInt();

    cout << fun(a, b, l, r, in_reader) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
